proposal: Start factors by type (hot 10, warm 15, cold 20 EOH).
question: With 20 EOH per start and the ER-01.03 regime (8,000 h and 250 starts per year) the hot gas path inspection falls every 1.9 years. The Owner will read ER-05.07 as about three years. Please give start factors by start type and the resulting calendar intervals for 180 hot / 60 warm / 10 cold starts per year.
response: Start factors: hot 10, warm 15, cold 20 EOH; trips from base load 60 EOH. For 8,000 h and 180 hot / 60 warm / 10 cold starts per year: 10,900 EOH per year, hot gas path at 25,000 EOH after about 2.3 years, major inspection after about 4.6 years. ER-05.07 (EOH-based) is met; the calendar interval is for the Owner to note.
subject: Hot gas path interval and EOH start factors (E-04)
